intended_object: An auxiliary construction (inferred from the docstring and name): from a witness that q is a product p · 1 in the homotopy-group multiplication of a Kan complex, it builds a witness that q is the product 1 · p.
explanation: The definition turns a `MulStruct p .const q i` into a `MulStruct .const p q i`, using `assoc'`, `oneMul`, `mulOne` and `oneMulEqSymm`. This is a proof step stated as data, because `MulStruct` is a structure carrying a simplex, not a Prop. It belongs to the internal construction of homotopy groups of Kan complexes and is not a standalone mathematical notion, so it has no literature counterpart to compare against.
